After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo: The 2nd hit of the attack changes into a multiple hit counter attack (Max 3 Consecutive Hits) that knocks enemies back. (Become temporarily invincible.)

skills.detail:
Skill 1 transforms into ""Black Hole" "Liberation"" when Power Gauge is at max.
Skill 1 turns back into "Darkness's Pull" when Power Gauge is no longer at max.

A long-range attack that pulls the enemy to your position.
Also deals a long-range area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.
Increases damage against [Power users].
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Darkness's Pull

skills.detail:
Skill 2 transforms into "Tremor Crush" when Power Gauge is at max.
Skill 2 turns back into "Tremor-Tremor Powers" when Power Gauge is no longer at max.

A long-range area attack with a chance to inflict Tremor.
Knocks enemies back if Tremor couldn't be applied.
Creates a shield that blocks close-range enemies' attacks and movement.
The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
skills.name: Tremor-Tremor Powers
